question: Where’s the closest restaurant you hit on the way to William and Ida Friday Institute for Educational Innovation, Raleigh, NC from Ganyard Hill Farms, Durham, NC?
sql: WITH origin AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Ganyard Hill Farms%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Durham%' LIMIT 1 ), destination AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%William and Ida Friday Institute for Educational Innovation%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Raleigh%' LIMIT 1 ), path_and_origin AS ( SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(origin.geometry, destination.geometry)::geography, 500) AS buffered_path_geom, origin.geometry AS origin_geom FROM origin, destination ) SELECT p.poi_name FROM pois AS p, path_and_origin AS pao WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, pao.buffered_path_geom) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, pao.origin_geom::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
